calls.title: Hampus / Scott and Ashley
calls.summary: The team discussed a dual-part educational content series aimed at improving Growth Book onboarding and establishing community trust through effective experimentation practices. Ashley proposed a two-part video series, which includes a walkthrough for setting up Growth Book and a guide on experiment design best practices using general principles. Additionally, the team emphasized the importance of non-salesy content that serves the broader community. They planned to mine customer insights for content ideas through AI tools and advocated for collaborative partnerships with CRO agencies to enhance Growth Book's reach. A developer-focused demo site was proposed to simplify onboarding, while an iterative content prioritization process was agreed upon to align community value with educational goals.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Experimentation Best Practices, Content Creation, Feature Flags, SEO Prioritization, Partner Agencies
